name: tracework
description: Evidence-backed daily, weekly, and monthly reports for agent work, with local decision replay when the work is questioned later.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed daily, weekly, and monthly reports for agent work
interface.longDescription: Close agent work into scoped daily, weekly, and monthly management narratives, capture key evidence with dynamic depth, recover missed sessions through opt-in Capture Day, and replay decisions when work is questioned or resumed.
defaultPrompt: Use Tracework to write a work-scoped daily report with /tracework:daily work.
Use Tracework to form this week's management judgment with /tracework:weekly work.
Use Tracework to create a raw-first monthly review with /tracework:monthly work.
Use Tracework to capture this key session with /tracework:capture.
Use Tracework to recover today's scoped session evidence with /tracework:capture day.
